annotations.title: Send a report or request to Moda

description:
Sends a report or request to Moda's team, the same as the form at modacommunities.com/report: a scam, an impersonator or a fake group; a deal dispute; a member conduct problem or ban appeal; group or chat access; a declined post; membership, advertising or billing; or a question for the team.
Moda's team receives it as a case, routed to the right person, and the person gets a case number and a confirmation email. Sending it means the person agrees to Moda's Terms (https://www.modacommunities.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.modacommunities.com/privacy); when a phone number is included, also to Moda contacting them by phone or text (msg and data rates may apply, reply STOP to opt out).
Required for every report: name, email, email_confirmed, category, description and agrees_to_terms. Each category also needs the details Moda's team otherwise has to ask for afterwards. For a deal dispute: related_post_link, other_party_profile (a profile link, not just a name), reference_check, amount, payment_method, key_dates and outcome_wanted. For a scam: related_post_link, other_party_profile and reference_check. For member conduct: related_group, other_party_profile and outcome_wanted. For account and access: facebook_profile and related_group, plus whatsapp_numbers for a number change. For posting and listing: related_group. For billing: order_number and amount. An honest answer such as "it was deleted" or "I don't know" is fine.
Screenshots cannot be attached here; the person replies to Moda's confirmation email with them.
Returns JSON with the case number; or, when details are missing, sent false and the questions to ask the person; or the reason it was not sent.

agrees_to_terms.description: true when the person has agreed to Moda's Terms and Privacy Policy (and, with a phone number, to calls and texts) for this report.

amount.description: Optional: the amount of money involved, for deal disputes and billing.

category.description: deal-dispute (Deal & Transaction Disputes), scam-fraud (Scam & Fraud), member-conduct (Member Conduct), account-access (Account & Access), posting-listing (Posting & Listing), membership (Membership), advertising (Advertising & Partnerships), billing (Billing), info-howto (Information & How-To), other (Other)

chat_name.description: Optional: the WhatsApp or Messenger chat it is about, when it is a chat rather than a group.

contacted_other_party.description: Optional: whether the person already contacted the other party, and what they said.

description.description: What happened or what the person needs, in their own words, with names, dates and amounts.

email.description: The person's email address, where the confirmation and Moda's replies go.

email_confirmed.description: true once the email address has been read back to the person and they confirmed it is right.

facebook_profile.description: Optional: the person's own Facebook profile link or exact profile name.

issue_type.description: deal-dispute: broken-deal (Broken deal or deal not honored), item-not-described (Item not as described), ghosting (Buyer or seller ghosting), slow-pay (Slow pay), shipping (Late shipping or shipping issues), wire-ship (Wire first or ship first dispute), middleman (Middleman request), large-wire (Large dollar wire dispute); scam-fraud: scam-report (Scam report), fake-group (Fake or copycat group report), reference-check (Ask whether someone is a Moda member); member-conduct: harassment (Harassment or interpersonal conflict), mod-complaint (Mod or admin complaint), ban-appeal (Why am I banned or ban appeal); account-access: cant-see-group (Can't see a group), chat-issue (Added to or removed from a chat), add-me (Add me to or send me a link to a group), number-change (Change my number on the WhatsApp chats); posting-listing: post-declined (Post declined or not approved), can-i-post (Can I post this), brokered (Brokered listing question), how-to-post (How to post); membership: what-tier (What tier do I need), how-upgrade (How do I upgrade), membership-benefits (What do I get with my membership); advertising: advertise (Advertise my business), partner (Partner or sponsor inquiry); billing: payment-issue (Payment or billing issue), refund (Refund request); info-howto: how-works (How does this work), right-contact (Who is the right contact), serial-check (Watch serial check or authentication), recommendation (Product or service recommendation); other: other (Other)

key_dates.description: For deal disputes: when the deal was made, when the item arrived (if it did), and when the person told the other party about the problem.

order_number.description: Optional: an order or invoice number, for billing.

other_party_profile.description: Optional: the Facebook profile link of the other person in a dispute or scam.

outcome_wanted.description: For deal disputes and member conduct: what the person wants, such as a refund, a return, or the other person to pay.

payment_email.description: For billing: the email address used to pay, if different.

payment_method.description: For deal disputes: how it was paid, such as wire (domestic or international), Zelle or other.

reference_check.description: For deal disputes and scams: whether a reference check was done before the deal.

reference_check_link.description: For deal disputes and scams: a link to the reference check or the public sold comment, if there is one.

related_group.description: The Moda group it is about, or Not group specific.

related_post_link.description: Optional: a link to the Facebook post or group involved.

request_type.description: question (Question), incident (Incident), problem (Problem), feature-request (Feature Request), refund (Refund)

whatsapp_numbers.description: For a WhatsApp number change: the old number and the new number.
